_comment: Pi GPIO config for rmr_bridge.py (pass with --io). Copy to rmr_io.json and edit. All sections are OPTIONAL — omit any you don't have. Pins are BCM GPIO numbers. SAFETY: the estop entries below act in SOFTWARE (send/echo M112) and are NOT a safety interlock — also fit a hardware E-stop that physically cuts stepper/ODrive motor power.
_comment_buttons: Momentary buttons → G-code. 'pull':'up' (default) = wire button between the GPIO pin and GND (internal pull-up, active-low). 'bounce' = debounce seconds.
_comment_tower: Status tower + buzzer, driven from machine state: green=ready/idle, amber=active (command sent in last ~1.5 s), red+buzzer=error or E-stop, red steady=serial down. Omit any channel you don't have. 'active_high':false for active-LOW relay/driver boards.
_comment_estop: OPTIONAL auxiliary contact of the hardware E-stop wired to a GPIO input, so the software knows it was hit (turns the tower red + buzzer, tells the UI, and — if 'cmd' is set — also sends it). Match 'pull' to your contact: default active-low (button/contact to GND). 'cmd':null to only annunciate.
